dz: 法国和印度战争：在纽约西部，英国军队从法国手中夺取了尼亚加拉堡，法国随后放弃了鲁耶堡。

te: The Battle of Minden, an allied Anglo-German army victory over the French. In Britain this was one of a number of event…
dz: 七年战争：明登战役，英德联军战胜法国。在英国，这是构成 1759 年奇迹周年的众多事件之一，并被某些英国陆军团庆祝为“明登日”。
de: Seven Years' War: The Battle of Minden, an allied Anglo-German army victory over the French. In Britain this was one of a number of events that constituted the Annus Mirabilis of 1759 and is celebrated as Minden Day by certain British Army regiments.
